title: Desarrollo y evaluación de uso de encuesta virtual de filtro sanitario en un sistema privado de educación básica de Baja California México durante contingencia sanitaria de SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19)
reasoning: The paper is a case study of a health screening survey implemented in a faith-based educational system (Adventist). While the context is a religious institution, the research itself does not evaluate or benchmark any aspect of religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The focus is on the logistics, implementation, and effectiveness of the health survey as a public health tool.
